backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing properties and user profiles with access control, property queries, and storage-backed image blobs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a specific autocomplete feature to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of summarized descriptions for key frontend files across layout, search, listings, and agent management.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens, theme variables, and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML wrapper mounting the React root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/google-site-verification: Empty placeholder file for Google site verification.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router setup with theme provider and routes for public, listing, and agent pages.
frontend/src/components/agent/MultiPhoto: Image uploader with progress tracking, validation, previews, and blob conversion for property photos.
frontend/src/components/agent/PropertyFo: Form for creating or editing properties with inputs, validation, and multi-photo upload integration.
frontend/src/components/auth/AgentProtec: Protects agent-only routes by checking authorization and redirecting or showing an access-denied card.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthLoadErr: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Renders the site footer with copyright info and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Displays the site header with logo, navigation, and link to the agent area.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Wraps pages with a header, footer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/listings/Contact: Generates a WhatsApp link prefilled with property details and renders a contact button.
frontend/src/components/listings/Propert: Shows a property preview card with image, details, and link to the full listing.
Displays main image and thumbnail carousel for a property's images.
frontend/src/components/search/PropertyS: Search bar allowing filtering of listings with location autocomplete and various criteria.
frontend/src/config/publicEnv.ts: Exports public environment variables like the Google Places API key.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: Provides a debounced version of a value updated after a delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useGooglePlacesAutoco: Hook that loads Google Places API and returns debounced UAE‑restricted autocomplete suggestions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and stored identity restoration. Wraps AuthClient setup and exposes status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocationAutocomple: Fetches backend-only location autocomplete suggestions using a query hook. Returns suggestions with loading and error state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profile, roles, property searches, and backend autocomplete. Wraps actor calls with debouncing, error handling, and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup with custom theme variables and component utility classes. Styles base elements and custom UI sections.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the root component. Imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentArenaEntry: Provides an agent login form that validates an access code and redirects to the agent dashboard. Handles errors and submission state.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentDashboardP: Agent dashboard showing property stats, quick actions, and logout handling with property counts by type.
frontend/src/pages/agent/ManagePropertie: Property management page listing all agent properties with options to add, edit, or delete, including authorization-aware error handling.
frontend/src/pages/agent/PropertyEditorP: Create/edit property form handling submission, loading states, and authorization-related errors.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailsPage.ts: Displays detailed information for a single property, including gallery, metadata, and agent contact. Handles loading and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/PublicListingsPage.ts: Renders a public property search page with hero section, search filters, and results grid. Shows loading, empty, and results states.
frontend/src/utils/agentCodeAuth.ts: Utility managing agent authorization using a stored code with methods to authorize, clear, and retrieve the code.
frontend/src/utils/backendError.ts: Normalizes backend errors and detects authorization-related messages.
frontend/src/utils/googlePlacesLoader.ts: Loader for Google Places API ensuring single-load behavior, readiness checks, and error reporting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, requirements, architectural notes, known issues, and feature list for a Dubai commercial property portal with an agent backend.
